subject: history
title: Recovery to Collapse Adventure
welcome_lead: Today you'll trace Germany from Stresemann's 'golden years' to Hitler's Chancellery.
meta_desc: GCSE History — Stresemann, Wall Street Crash and Hitler's rise.
final_note: You learned how the Depression destroyed Weimar and brought Hitler to power.

walkthroughs.body_html:
In late 1923 Gustav Stresemann ended hyperinflation by issuing the Rentenmark.

The Dawes Plan (1924) brought US loans. The Locarno Pact (1925) and League membership (1926) restored Germany's status. The 1929 Young Plan cut reparations further.

The Wall Street Crash in October 1929 ended US loans.

Unemployment hit 6 million by 1932. Chancellors Brüning and Papen ruled by Article 48 decree. Voters turned to extremes — Nazis rose from 12 seats in 1928 to 230 in July 1932.

Papen persuaded President Hindenburg that Hitler could be controlled.

On 30 January 1933 Hitler became Chancellor. Within weeks the Reichstag Fire let him ban communists. The Enabling Act of March 1933 gave him dictator's powers.

mcqs.q: How did Hitler come to power in 1933?
options: He was legally appointed Chancellor by President Hindenburg as part of a conservative political deal, after the Nazis became the largest party in the Reichstag.
The hyperinflation was caused by the Wall Street Crash.
Hitler won an outright majority in the 1932 presidential election.
Hitler seized power through a violent coup or revolution.

mcqs.q: What caused the German hyperinflation of 1923?
options: The hyperinflation was caused by the Wall Street Crash.
Reparations alone caused the hyperinflation.
The government printing money to pay striking workers during the French occupation of the Ruhr, on top of existing reparations and war debts.
The fire destroyed all of Berlin and forced people to support the Nazis.

mcqs.q: What was the political significance of the Reichstag Fire?
options: Hitler personally set the fire and blamed it on the Communists.
The fire destroyed all of Berlin and forced people to support the Nazis.
Hitler won an outright majority in the 1932 presidential election.
Hitler used it to issue the Reichstag Fire Decree suspending civil liberties, jail Communists, and create the conditions for the Enabling Act of March 1933.
